name: My inner shadow
source:
A visual novel trying to give a view into the thoughts and doubts of a person affected by mental illnesses, like depression, borderline or anxiety.

[From [url=https://tinykobl.itch.io/my-inner-shadow-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部视觉小说，试图了解受抑郁、边缘或焦虑等精神疾病影响的人的想法和疑虑。

[来自[url=https://tinykobl.itch.io/my-inner-shadow-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
